citation: Suitability ranges compiled from ICAR crop production guides and State Agricultural University package-of-practices. Climate suitability (temperature/rainfall) is scored by Module C, not here.

crops.name: Rice
crops.notes: Tolerates poor drainage and standing water; best on heavy soils that hold water.

crops.name: Wheat
crops.notes: Needs well-drained medium soils; sensitive to waterlogging and salinity.

crops.name: Cotton
crops.notes: Deep black (Vertisol) soils are ideal; tolerates mild alkalinity.

crops.name: Groundnut
crops.notes: Needs loose, friable, well-drained light soil for peg penetration; add gypsum at flowering.

crops.name: Pearl millet (Bajra)
crops.notes: Very drought- and heat-tolerant; grows on poor light soils and mild alkalinity.

crops.name: Sorghum (Jowar)
crops.notes: Wide adaptability; tolerates short drought and moderate alkalinity.

crops.name: Chickpea (Gram)
crops.notes: Legume; fixes N and suits residual soil moisture. Avoid waterlogging and acid soils.

crops.name: Soybean
crops.notes: Legume; needs well-drained medium soil with good organic matter.

crops.name: Maize
crops.notes: Heavy feeder; needs fertile well-drained soil and cannot tolerate waterlogging.

crops.name: Sugarcane
crops.notes: Long-duration, high water and nutrient demand; needs deep fertile soil.

crops.name: Mustard
crops.notes: Suited to light-to-medium soils on residual moisture; mildly salt-tolerant.
